note.zh-TW: 台灣證券信用交易用語。教材的追繳門檻與補繳期限可能和現行規定不同，上線前要查現行條文（T18）；追繳門檻是參數。
note.en: A Taiwanese margin trading term. The course's maintenance threshold and top-up deadline may differ from current rules and must be checked before launch (T18); the threshold is a parameter.

definition.zh-TW: 融資買股票時，擔保品市值相對於融資金額的比率。數值越低表示擔保越不夠，跌到追繳門檻以下會被要求補錢。
definition.en: When shares are bought on margin, the market value of the collateral relative to the loan. A lower value means thinner cover; falling below the maintenance threshold triggers a margin call.

ifrsNote.zh-TW: 這不是會計比率，IFRS 沒有對應名詞；它屬於證券信用交易的規定。
ifrsNote.en: This is not an accounting ratio and IFRS has no corresponding term; it belongs to securities margin trading rules.
